carriedExternalInspections.title: Formal verification
carriedExternalInspections.publisher: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures
carriedExternalInspections.scope: Defines formal verification through formal requirements, a model, logic, and rules of inference.
carriedExternalInspections.boundary: Does not establish that a particular model matches the implemented system or that a particular proof is sound.

carriedExternalInspections.accessBasis: Published online by the authors, freely readable.
carriedExternalInspections.reuseBasis: Reference-only. Bounded original summary; the text is not copied into artifacts.
carriedExternalInspections.supportedClaimScope: That an error budget is derived from a service level objective and states, as an objective metric, how unreliable a service is permitted to be within a defined period.
carriedExternalInspections.boundary: Describes one organisation’s published practice, not a standard. It sets no budget for any service, and an error budget bounds permitted unreliability rather than measuring correctness.
carriedExternalInspections.relationshipToEarlier: Carried forward into Tranche 18: same source, same locator, same claim scope. Originally inspected as tr15-src-102.

carriedExternalInspections.title: The International System of Units (SI Brochure)
carriedExternalInspections.scope: Defines dimensions of base and derived quantities and their expression as products of base dimensions.
carriedExternalInspections.boundary: Does not validate a particular equation, measurement, unit conversion, or uncertainty budget.

carriedExternalInspections.title: IERS Conventions (2010), Chapter 5
carriedExternalInspections.publisher: International Earth Rotation and Reference Systems Service
carriedExternalInspections.locator: Chapter 5, transformation between the ITRS and GCRS
carriedExternalInspections.scope: Specifies the sequence and quantities used to transform between terrestrial and celestial reference systems.
carriedExternalInspections.boundary: Does not establish that a software implementation uses the correct epoch, Earth-orientation parameters, units, or convention version.

carriedExternalInspections.title: DLMF §3.1 — Arithmetics and Error Measures
carriedExternalInspections.scope: Defines floating-point representation and rounding conventions.
carriedExternalInspections.boundary: Does not establish bit-for-bit deterministic results across hardware, compilers, libraries, execution order, or implementations.

carriedExternalInspections.title: Causal Inference: What If
carriedExternalInspections.publisher: Chapman & Hall/CRC; author-hosted copy at Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health
carriedExternalInspections.locator: Chapter 1, p. 12, “A definition of causal effect”
carriedExternalInspections.scope: Defines causal effects as contrasts under alternative treatments in a target population and distinguishes causal from associational quantities.
carriedExternalInspections.boundary: Does not establish identification for a particular dataset, the validity of a causal model, or an effect estimate.

carriedExternalInspections.sourceIdentity: PubMed Central, Author Manuscripts in PMC
carriedExternalInspections.locator: Section "What is the Author Manuscript?" — first paragraph.
carriedExternalInspections.accessBasis: United States government service, freely accessible.
carriedExternalInspections.reuseBasis: US government work; bounded original summary with attribution.
carriedExternalInspections.supportedClaimScope: That versions of one work stand in a stated relationship — accepted manuscript versus published record — differing by the edits each contains.
carriedExternalInspections.boundary: Supports the existence of a version relationship for journal articles. It does not generalise to other artifact types and establishes no versioning scheme.
carriedExternalInspections.relationshipToEarlier: Carried forward into Tranche 18: same source, same locator, same claim scope. Originally inspected as tr13-src-020.

carriedExternalInspections.sourceIdentity: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations
carriedExternalInspections.locator: Control AU-3 (Content of Audit Records), items a-f and the Discussion paragraph.
carriedExternalInspections.accessBasis: United States government publication, freely available.
carriedExternalInspections.reuseBasis: US government work; bounded original summary with attribution.
carriedExternalInspections.supportedClaimScope: That an audit record is expected to carry the event description, timestamp, source, outcome and the identity of entities associated with the event, and that audit trails can reveal personally identifiable information, which the organisation is expected to consider and mitigate.
carriedExternalInspections.boundary: Specifies record content, not an export format, retention period or disclosure rule. The privacy caution is a consideration the standard raises, not a permission to export.
carriedExternalInspections.relationshipToEarlier: Carried forward into Tranche 18: same source, same locator, same claim scope. Originally inspected as tr14-src-102.

carriedExternalInspections.title: DLMF §3.3 — Interpolation
carriedExternalInspections.scope: Defines polynomial interpolation through distinct nodes and identifies other interpolation methods.
carriedExternalInspections.boundary: Does not establish accuracy between nodes, suitability for extrapolation, or numerical stability for a particular implementation.

carriedExternalInspections.title: DLMF §3.8 — Nonlinear Equations
carriedExternalInspections.scope: Defines bracketing and iterative methods for locating zeros, with conditions and accuracy or conditioning considerations.
carriedExternalInspections.boundary: Does not establish convergence for an arbitrary starting value or certify a computed root without residual and conditioning evidence.

carriedExternalInspections.title: A Methodology for Numerical Software Testing
carriedExternalInspections.scope: Distinguishes an ill-conditioned problem from an unstable algorithm and bounds stability by comparison with inherent error.
carriedExternalInspections.boundary: Does not establish the stability of a named algorithm without an analysis under its stated inputs and arithmetic.

carriedExternalInspections.title: PERK specification
carriedExternalInspections.scope: Defines commitment algorithms, correctness, computational hiding, and computational binding.
carriedExternalInspections.boundary: A candidate submission hosted by NIST is not a NIST standard or endorsement and does not establish security of an implementation.

carriedExternalInspections.title: DLMF §3.1(ii) — Interval Arithmetic
carriedExternalInspections.scope: Defines interval arithmetic as producing inclusion regions and states the restriction on division by an interval containing zero.
carriedExternalInspections.boundary: Does not certify an interval implementation, a rounding mode, or the tightness of a computed bound.

carriedExternalInspections.boundary: The full subscribed standard was not inspected; this source cannot supply clause-level normative requirements.
